'''Danny Hummel''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Denver World Qualifier]] on 30 June 2001 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC]], according to Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2663">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-parker-co-6-30-01day-2-electric-boogalood2663/ parker-co-6-30-01day-2-electric-boogaloo], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 19 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-parker-co-6-30-01day-2-electric-boogalood2663/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
